cards.text: The crowd in Jerusalem is divided over who Jesus is, and the religious leaders are arguing about Him too. Then each went to his own home. But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives, a hill just outside the city.
Early in the morning, Jesus is back in the temple courts, and ALL the people come to Him. Early. ALL. Friend, I can't even get MYSELF up early, and I sleep right next to the oven.

cards.question: With all those people gathered around Him in the temple courts, what does Jesus do?

answers.text: He sits down to teach them
He sends them home to rest
He leads them in a song

cards.text: Then the scribes and Pharisees, experts in the Law and a strict group of religious leaders, bring in a woman caught in adultery and make her stand before them. They say, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.”

cards.question: Then the scribes and Pharisees bring up the Law. They tell Jesus that ___ commanded them to stone such a woman.

answers.text: Moses
Aaron
Joshua

cards.question: The scribes and Pharisees finish with, “So what do You say?” Why are they really asking Jesus this?

answers.text: To test Him and find a reason to accuse Him
To learn from Him what the Law means
To show the whole crowd they respect Him

cards.question: With everyone in the temple courts waiting on His answer, what does Jesus do?

answers.text: He writes on the ground with His finger
He picks up a stone from the ground
He walks out of the temple courts

cards.text: The passage never tells us what He wrote. But the scribes and Pharisees won't let it go, and they keep questioning Him.

cards.question: Jesus straightens up and answers the scribes and Pharisees. Who does He say should be the first to throw a stone at the woman?

answers.text: Whoever among them is without sin
Whoever caught her in the act
Whoever knows the Law the best

cards.text: One line. That's all He says. And again He bent down and wrote on the ground.

cards.question: When the scribes and Pharisees hear what Jesus said, they begin to ___ one by one.

answers.text: leave
shout
pray

cards.question: The youngest of the woman's accusers are the first ones to walk away.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: One by one they're gone, until only Jesus was left, with the woman standing there. It's like a group chat after somebody asks who's covering the bill. Everybody just quietly slips away.

cards.question: Jesus straightens up and speaks to the woman. What does He ask her?

answers.text: Where her accusers have gone
Why she came to the temple
Who brought her to the courts

cards.question: Jesus asks the woman if anyone has condemned her. She answers that ___ has.

answers.text: nobody
everybody
somebody

cards.question: Then Jesus answers the woman. What does He tell her?

answers.text: He doesn't condemn her and she should sin no more
He condemns her but she may go back home
She must go and offer a sacrifice for her sin
